prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE small Victoria 3 naval designer COG TROOP TRANSPORT accommodations/supply equipment UI icon. Image 1 STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: native miniature painted embossed monochrome metal glyphs with broad shading and thin dark bevel edges.
Not a full ship, not a realistic picture, not an architectural plan. One compact emblem made from a few large distinctive objects on a SMALL ship interior/deck fragment. Three-quarter isometric from slightly above, coherent common perspective. All rectangular boards, frames and supports use the same two isometric directions; no impossible intersections, floating pillars or misaligned feet. Everything, including wood and fabric, in ONE monochrome metallic BRONZE palette. Center complete silhouette with generous padding, readable at 32px. Truly transparent background and gaps; solid opaque artwork, no external shadow, halo, glow, haze or vignette. No text, numbers, people, giant building, entire ship hull, water, scenery or mechanical engines. Keep elements very simple; distinct shape reflecting TRANSPORT OF TROOPS, not just more crates or bigger barrels.
LOW warm metallic BRONZE: small open empty wooden cargo-hold fragment, ONE shallow rectangular planked floor and ONE short rear curved ship side. A single tightly rolled sleeping blanket rests beside ONE small plain lashed sea chest on the floor. Dominant silhouette a LOW OPEN wooden hold with improvised bedding, no elevated structures, no bunk framework, no stairs and no hatch. Large simple shapes, all tinted bronze, no extra tiny cargo.
